response.what_it_is: PlayStation 4 Slim console with two boxed wireless controllers
visible_condition: console body appears clean and intact
hidden_risks: whether the controllers are genuine Sony DualShock 4 or counterfeit clones
internal condition, dust accumulation, and potential fan noise
console firmware version and online ban status
actual working condition of ports and disc drive
response.best_proof: A photo or video showing the console powered on, displaying the system software version and dashboard.
seller_claims_unsupported: inclusion and functionality of specific games
controllers being brand new original equipment
response.failure_mode: Valuing the bundle assuming the controllers are genuine brand-new Sony pads and the firmware is verifiable without visual or software proof.
